description: This file defines a Perl package for a ResultSet class related to ingredients in a schema, providing methods for copying data from another result set, sorting, and filtering based on preparation status.
external_files: possibly other ResultSet classes for DishIngredient and RecipeIngredient

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::ResultSet::Ingredient
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling collections of Ingredient schema objects, with methods for copying, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: copy_from_rs
methods.description: Copies ingredient data from another result set, selecting specific columns and populating the current result set.

methods.name: prepared
methods.description: Filters the result set to only include ingredients marked as prepared.

methods.name: not_prepared
methods.description: Filters the result set to only include ingredients not marked as prepared.
